in_sanskrit.name: Yaginansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Sacrifice
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Yaginansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Yaginansh is a Sanskrit name derived from two words 'Yajna' and 'Ansh'. 'Yajna' means sacrifice and 'Ansh' means God or essence. Thus, Yaginansh means 'God of Sacrifice'. It is a name given to a baby boy born in a family that believes in the power of sacrifice.
